  "score": 85,
  "strengths": [
    "Built a real‑world inventory service using the exact required stack (Java 17, Spring Boot, MySQL).",
    "Showed end‑to‑end ownership: database design, SQL reporting, and API documentation for a frontend team.",
    "Uses Git for version control and is actively learning Docker, covering both nice‑to‑have skills."
  ],
  "gaps": [
    "No mention of automated testing (unit/integration) or CI/CD pipelines.",
    "Limited evidence of performance tuning or security hardening experience.",
    "Only volunteer experience described; no indication of collaborative code‑review practices in a team setting."
  ],
  "improvements": [
    "Add concrete metrics (e.g., items tracked, query response times) to quantify impact.",
    "Include any testing frameworks used (JUnit, Testcontainers) and CI setup.",
    "Reference relevant coursework, certifications, or personal projects that demonstrate deeper Spring or Docker knowledge."
  ]
}
